name: Brevard County, FL
findings: Brevard County has 1,743 nonprofit organizations. 619 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 482 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Brevard County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
